description: Java class defining a validator for RabbitMQ connections within an Eclipse Ditto messaging service, including validation logic for source and target configurations, URI schemes, and payload mappings.

classes.name: RabbitMQValidator
classes.description: Final class that extends AbstractProtocolValidator to provide validation logic specific to RabbitMQ protocol connections, including source and target validation, scheme validation, and payload mapping checks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of RabbitMQValidator.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration of a connection, including enforcement templates and header mappings.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration, including header mappings and address templates.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type, which is AMQP 0.9.1 for this validator.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs overall validation of the connection, including URI scheme validation, source and target configs, and payload mappings.
